# ClickOut

> ClickOut is India's all-in-one retail operating ecosystem — queue-free self-checkout, inventory management, fraud prevention, employee authentication, and multi-store analytics in one platform.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2024, Mumbai, India
- Category: Retail Management Software / Point-of-Sale System
- Target: Retail stores, supermarkets, chains, warehouses
- Pricing: ₹99–₹699/month + Enterprise

## Core Features
- [Self-Checkout](https://www.clickout.in/features/self-checkout)
- [Inventory Management](https://www.clickout.in/features/inventory-management)
- [Analytics Dashboard](https://www.clickout.in/features/analytics)
- [Fraud Prevention](https://www.clickout.in/features/fraud-prevention)
- [Employee Verification](https://www.clickout.in/features/employee-verification)
